RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor in the appointment. While an all-male panel may reflect institutional diversity shortcomings or a breach of internal university committee-composition guidelines, it provides no basis for an individual claim of sex discrimination. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would undermine your credibility and distract from legitimate procedural inquiries. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. If any non-academic factor or bias influenced the decision, issues such as age or a strategic departmental preference for industry experience are far more relevant than sex.
